title: Not Percale as Discribe
text: Not Percale as Discribe. These are 100% cotton. However, they are not Percale as stated in discription. Percale has a cool and crispy feel, these do not. In fact these felt stiff until I washed them a few times using extra fabric softener. Over all a good set but will not order again. Will be looking for a true Percale sheet set.
